cardEffects:
You may digivolve this card from your hand onto one of your red Tamers as if that card is a level 3 red Digimon.
[When Digivolving] If [BurningGreymon] is in this Digimon's digivolution cards or you have a blue or green Digimon or Tamer, this Digimon may digivolve into [AncientGreymon] in the hand for a digivolution cost of 3, ignoring its digivolution requirements. If digivolved by this effect, delete this Digimon at the end of the turn.
name: Agunimon

references.text: Official JP Q&A for BT17-011 (2024/09/20, translated by DeepL)

rulings.answer: No, [Takuya Kanbara] digivolves as a Tamer.
rulings.question: Does this card's "[Takuya Kanbara]: Cost 2" digivolution requirement mean that [Takuya Kanbara] is treated as a Digimon when it digivolves?

rulings.answer: No, they don’t trigger.  "When a Digimon digivolves" effects don't trigger when a Tamer digivolves.
rulings.question: If I use this card's "[Takuya Kanbara]: Cost 2" digivolution requirement to digivolve, do "when a Digimon digivolves" effects trigger?

rulings.answer: No, they don’t trigger.  "When a Digimon digivolves" effects don't trigger when a Tamer digivolves.
rulings.question: If I use this card's "[Takuya Kanbara]: Cost 2" digivolution requirement to digivolve, do "when a Digimon would digivolve" effects trigger?

rulings.answer: Yes, you can.  Because you're digivolving from a Tamer, it isn't considered an unsuspended Digimon.
rulings.question: My opponent activates EX3-053 [Metallicdramon]'s [On Play] effect. Can I digivolve an unsuspended [Takuya Kanbara] using this card's "[Takuya Kanbara]: Cost 2" digivolution requirement in the next turn?

rulings.answer: No, you can't.  P-103 [Offense Training]'s ＜Delay＞ effect digivolves 1 Digimon. It doesn't digivolve Tamers.
rulings.question: Can I activate P-103 [Offense Training]'s ＜Delay＞ effect and digivolve using this card's "[Takuya Kanbara]: Cost 2" digivolution requirement to digivolve?

rulings.answer: Digimon carry over effects after digivolving or de-digivolving, therefore it's deleted at the end of the turn.
rulings.question: If I use this Digimon's [When Digivolving] effect to digivolve into [AncientGreymon], then it digivolves or is affected by ＜De-Digivolve＞, what happens to the "delete this Digimon at the end of this turn" effect?

rulings.answer: No, it isn't deleted because it's no longer considered a Digimon.
rulings.question: This Digimon has a Tamer card in its digivolution cards, and I used its [When Digivolving] effect to digivolve into [AncientGreymon], then it was affected by a ＜De-Digivolve＞ effect and became a Tamer. Does the "delete this Digimon at the end of this turn" effect delete this Tamer at such times?

rulings.answer: Digimon carry over effects after digivolving, therefore it plays [AncientGreymon].
rulings.question: I used BT3-109 [Back for Revenge!] on this Digimon, then I used this Digimon's [When Digivolving] effect to digivolve into [AncientGreymon]. After this Digimon is deleted at the end of this turn, does BT3-109 [Back for Revenge!]'s effect play this card or [AncientGreymon] into the battle area?

rulings.answer: No, it is not deleted. Effects that are processed when a specific timing is reached are processed as triggered when the timing is reached. If the Digivolved by this card's effect at the end of the turn, the "Delete this Digimon at the end of this turn" of this card is not processed because the timing to be at the end of the turn has passed.
rulings.question: I have a situation where I have my "BT17-012 BurningGreymon" with "BT18-088 Takuya Kanbara & Koji Minamoto" as its digivolution card. At the End of Turn, "BT17-012 Vritramon" attacked by the digivolving source effect of "BT18-088 Takuya Kanbara & Koji Minamoto", and "BT17-012 Vritramon" digivolved to this card by its [When Attacking] effect. At this time, if this card's [When Digivolving] effect evolved into "AncientGreymon", will that "AncientGreymon" be deleted by this card's effect, even though the timing when the turn ended has already passed?
